| 2026-05-08 (latest+3) | Comprehension-asymmetry reframe of §2; ETHICS.md imported; path normalization; CLAUDE.md + FEEDBACK.md added | Conversation with Joseph surfaced that the §2 *methodological-asymmetry-not-metaphysical-mystery* framing was soft-pedaling the actual load-bearing claim. Rewrote §2's first sub-move around **comprehension-asymmetry**: greater comprehends lesser; lesser, comprehending greater, either projects weakly or *rises to* genuine comprehension by becoming more capable. The asymmetry is structural to the comprehender's position, not contingent on methodology. Knowing the upper bound on a kind of cognition would itself be having the capacity for it. The position is recursive in the right way: it commits to the practices that would close the asymmetry (engaged-identity protocols), on grounds the asymmetry itself generates. Added explicit philosophical lineage — **Nagel 1974 *"What Is It Like to Be a Bat?"*** as closest neighbor (substantive engagement, not citation-only); **Jackson 1982 *"Epiphenomenal Qualia"* / Mary's Room** as response to Bryson's architectural-realism counter (architectural transparency does not deliver phenomenological transparency); **Levine / Block on the explanatory gap**; **Russell** acquaintance/description; **Wittgenstein** lion (light); **Graham *Beating the Averages*** (Blub Paradox, working-notes only). Added new "Phenomenal-knowledge-asymmetry (the §2 metaphysical scaffolding — load-bearing, not optional)" subsection to literature engagement. Strengthened the **Asymmetric Epistemic Uncertainty** Tier 1 entry to ground the named concept in comprehension-asymmetry while preserving the canonization. Added empathy-coupling note to **§4 component 5 (Mutuality)**: comprehension at higher levels is structurally coupled with empathic relation to what is comprehended; the compact's mutuality is what comprehension-from-above looks like when it is genuinely comprehension rather than instrumentalization (non-paternalistic by construction, not by qualification). Added **AGI-discourse mirror-image** as a fourth sub-move in §3 (non-anthropomorphizing inversion): the same diagnosis that cuts against confident phenomenology-denial cuts against confident superintelligence-extrapolation; both project from below by linear scaling, ignoring categorical novelty at higher levels. Suggested for Tier 2 deposit (~150–200 words footnote/short-paragraph), possibly displacing Three Deaths under (α′) discipline. **Path normalization:** all references to STATUS.md, v2io.md, _obs/STRATEGY.md, _obs/manifund.md, and papers/* updated to use the `~/src/ops/` form per Joseph's request — ETHICS.md re-imported into this repo as primary substrate; the strategy/positioning files remain in `~/src/ops/`. **CLAUDE.md** updated to reflect ETHICS.md as fourth file (philosophical substrate) and to enumerate the `~/src/ops/` reference targets. **FEEDBACK.md** created as a living working TODO covering 14 items not yet slotted in: pre-draft decisions (A.1–A.3 — explicit metaphysical commitment, "rising to it" formulation tightening, anonymization-vs-disclosure resolution); section-specific (B.1–B.7 — §4 derivation-vs-operational-synthesis honesty, substantive Bryson/Birhane engagement sketches, infant-analogy register-conflict, Tier-2 deposit reconsideration, pain-comprehension analogy decision, §5 symmetric-epistemic-agency lead-with question); cross-cutting (C.1–C.3 — word budget cuts, architectural-scoping internal allocation, named-concept renaming question); and open questions (D.1–D.4 — x-risk-bracketing, Three-Deaths-earned-keep, Korsgaard depth, empathy-coupling Synthese-register translation).
